servinfo.title: Precautions for Removing / Installing and Replacing Blind Spot Monitor Control Module

item.ptxt: After removing / installing or replacing blind spot monitor control module, perform Millimeter Wave Radar Aiming Adjustment:Blind Spot Monitor .
When installing blind spot monitor control module, check that the mounting portion is not damaged or deformed.
Do not disassemble blind spot monitor control module. If disassembled, replace it.

If blind spot monitor control module is exposed to a large shock, it will lose its original performance. Do not drop the control module. If the control module is exposed to a large shock, replace it even if the appearance is normal.

A vehicle that was involved in an accident could be exposed to a large shock and the blind spot monitor control module might have lost its original performance. Perform Millimeter Wave Radar Aiming Adjustment:Blind Spot Monitor for the accident vehicle and replace the control module if any abnormality is found.
